narratives.body: Martin Demichelis, RB Leipzig coach, praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Real Madrid clash. Yahoo and Yardbarker reported that Demichelis raved about the player before the Champions League tie at the Bernabeu. OneFootball also noted Demichelis hailing Diomande before the match.
narratives.headline: Demichelis praises Yan Diomande ahead of Real Madrid clash
